profile.headline: Product Designer | Enterprise SaaS, Mobile & Design Systems | Front-End Fluency + AI-Assisted Product Delivery
profile.summary:
I design complex products that feel clear, useful, and buildable.
For 6+ years, I’ve worked across enterprise operations, digital mail SaaS, financial services, mobile navigation, and independent products. At The Villages, I design and build digital experiences within a 200K+ user ecosystem. At Quadient, I owned end-to-end UX/UI for Switch workflows serving 15K+ users. My independent work includes Payro Finance, where I connected application, verification, funding, and account management in one responsive product system.

I’m a designer who understands how products get built. My front-end background helps me identify constraints early, collaborate directly with engineering, and protect the experience through implementation.
I also use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate research synthesis, prototyping, documentation, and production delivery while keeping product judgment, accessibility, and visual craft human-led.
I’m interested in product design opportunities where I can simplify difficult systems, strengthen design-engineering collaboration, and help teams ship thoughtful products.

Portfolio: https://jeremy-portfolio-v1.vercel.app/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and build Golf Rail and vehicle-specific navigation experiences within a 200K+ user product ecosystem.
• Create clearer mobile download and navigation journeys for an older demographic, supporting adoption and retention.
• Translate Figma concepts into production-ready interfaces using Angular and .NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid.
• Partner with engineering and stakeholders to surface constraints early, define reusable patterns, and improve handoff quality.
• Apply AI-assisted workflows to accelerate research synthesis, prototyping, documentation, and implementation while protecting accessibility and product quality.

positions.title: UX/UI Designer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed responsive websites, SaaS dashboards, and reusable component systems for independent clients.
• Built scalable Figma systems and engineering-ready specifications for responsive implementation.
• Used research, rapid prototyping, and AI-assisted workflows to explore solutions, document decisions, and move from concept to production efficiently.

positions.title: UX/UI Designer
positions.description:
• Owned end-to-end UX/UI for Switch by Quadient across onboarding, document preparation, address verification, payment, account management, and physical-mail workflows.
• Designed within a SaaS product environment serving 15K+ users across desktop and mobile.
• Reduced delivery risk with high-fidelity Figma prototypes, reusable components, responsive states, and detailed engineering documentation.
• Partnered with product, engineering, clients, and stakeholders to turn complex mailing operations into clearer, more usable journeys.
• Supported implementation and deployment workflows using React, CSS, GCP, Firebase, Visual Studio, Figma, and Asana.
positions.insights: Skills: UX Research · Figma · React.js · Front-End Development · User Interface Design · Rapid Prototyping

positions.title: UX/UI Designer
positions.description:
• Designed WCAG-conscious websites, dashboards, and mobile experiences across client and internal products.
• Produced high-fidelity Figma prototypes that reduced typical delivery cycles from roughly five weeks to two.
• Facilitated stakeholder workshops and reusable-component planning that reduced development timelines by 20%.
• Built reusable components and responsive patterns for iOS, Android, HubSpot, WordPress, Webflow, and Shopify experiences.
• Partnered with developers through documented Figma and Asana handoffs and supported deployment workflows using GCP and Firebase.

positions.title: User Experience Designer Intern
positions.description:
• Created responsive UI components with React, JavaScript, CSS/SCSS, and Flexbox.
• Built rapid Adobe XD prototypes and collaborated with developers through Git, GitHub, and Slack.
• Supported accessible WordPress experiences using WCAG-conscious patterns and testing.
• Documented design decisions to improve handoff clarity and reduce avoidable development rework.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description:
• Delivered technical support and product guidance for phones, tablets, laptops, and connected services.
• Combined troubleshooting with consultative sales, contributing to a 15% increase in sales revenue.
• Used diagnostic and account-management tools to resolve customer issues and consistently exceed monthly targets.
• Built strong customer relationships while translating technical information into clear, practical guidance.
